title: Services Schema
description: Provider-scoped postal add-on services. Identity is `id`. `name` is the operator’s original name; `label` is English. `kind` is cross-provider grouping only (not unique, not a graph key).

id.description: Concrete provider-scoped service id. Graph, prices, and rules use this — the only identifier.

kind.description: Cross-provider semantic grouping (e.g. registered). Not unique. Resolver may map kind to this provider’s ids. Graph and prices use `id`, not kind.

label.description: English human-readable label for unified tooling and docs

requires.description: Optional extra inputs this service always needs. Omit when none. Registered mail does not imply ADDRESS_*.

features.description: Feature `id` values from features.json (concrete ids only, not kind). Empty when the service is only a priced add-on (e.g. DE Zusatzversicherung is not Sendungsnummer). A service enables tracking iff any entry is a feature whose kind is tracking.

supported_zones.description: Zone IDs where this service is orderable via API. When omitted, service is available for all zones the product supports. Used for wire-specific API restrictions.

combinable_with.description: Service IDs this service can be combined with in a single order. Source of truth for multi-select; consumers must not invent exclusivity heuristics — declare edges here when variants are mutually exclusive.
